help.title: Help and questions
help.intro: Quick answers about ordering, delivery and payment.
help.a1: Choose what you want, add it to the basket and press Order on WhatsApp. Fill in your details once, check the message, and send it in WhatsApp. For parcels and anything else, use the short form on that page.
help.q2: Do I need an account or to pay online?
help.a2: No account and no online payment. You pay cash or by QR (eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay) when your order arrives.
help.a3: It depends on how far we travel and what you order. We confirm the exact charge on WhatsApp before a rider is sent.
help.a4: Every day from {open} to {close}, Nepal time. You can browse any time, but orders can only be sent while we are open.
help.q5: Which areas do you deliver to?
help.a5: Dharan and nearby areas in every direction, including Itahari and Biratnagar. See the Where we deliver page, or choose Other area when you order and we will tell you if we can come.
help.a6: Yes. Choose Later in your details, then pick today or tomorrow and a time during opening hours, at least 30 minutes from now. Gift orders choose their own date and time.
help.q7: How do I share my location?
help.a7: Tap Share my location in your details. Your phone asks permission once, and the map link is added to your WhatsApp message. The website never saves it.
help.q8: Can I change or cancel my order?
help.a8: Message us on WhatsApp as early as you can. We can usually change or cancel before the shop starts preparing it. Once it is being prepared or is on the way, changes may not be possible.
help.q9: Something is wrong with my order.
help.a9: Wrong item, missing item or a late order? Message us on WhatsApp as soon as you notice, ideally within 24 hours, with your order details. We will look into it and do our best to put it right.
help.a10: Liquor is for adults aged 18 and over. We check ID at the door and may refuse delivery without it.
help.a11: Some offers come with a code. Type it in your basket. If it is valid, it is added to your WhatsApp message and we apply the offer when we confirm your order.
help.q12: How do I repeat my last order?
help.a12: On the home page, or in an empty basket, tap Order again. We check today’s prices and what is still available.
help.a13: The website does not store your name, phone number or location. They stay on your phone to save typing, and in your WhatsApp message to us. See the Privacy page.
help.q14: I own a café or shop. Can I join?
help.a14: Yes. Use Partner with us. Riders can apply there too.
help.stuckBody: Message us on WhatsApp or call. We reply during opening hours.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: What this website does with your information, in plain words.
privacy.s1Body: Chitto Mitho is a delivery service in Dharan, Nepal. This page explains what this website does with your information.
privacy.s2Title: What the website does not store
privacy.s2Body: The website does not store your name, phone number, address, landmark or location. Orders are not placed on the website. They are written into a WhatsApp message that you send yourself.
privacy.s3Body: When you open WhatsApp to send an order, the website adds one anonymous line to a counter: the kind of order (for example food), the café, the items total and the area. It contains nothing that identifies you. We use it to see how many orders arrive.
privacy.s4Body: To save you typing, your phone’s browser remembers your name, phone number, area, landmark and payment choice, your basket, your last order, your language, and whether you confirmed you are 18 or over for this visit. This stays on your phone. You can clear it in your browser settings at any time.
privacy.s5Body: If you tap Share my location, your phone asks for permission and puts your position into the WhatsApp message as a map link. The website does not save it, and it asks again for every order.
privacy.s6Body: Your message goes to our WhatsApp number. We use what you send only to confirm and deliver your order and to help you if something goes wrong. WhatsApp’s own privacy policy applies to messages sent through WhatsApp.
privacy.s7Body: The website is hosted on Vercel and its menus are stored with Supabase. Like most websites, the host keeps basic technical records of visits. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies. Links to Google Maps, TikTok or Instagram only leave this site if you tap them.
privacy.s8Body: You can clear the information on your phone at any time, or ask us on WhatsApp about a conversation you had with us. Liquor orders are for adults aged 18 and over.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: The simple rules for ordering with Chitto Mitho.
terms.s1Body: Chitto Mitho is a delivery service. This website helps you choose what you want and prepares an order message for WhatsApp. An order is only accepted when we confirm it with you on WhatsApp.
terms.s2Body: Prices and items come from the menus shown and can change. If something is sold out or a price has changed, we will tell you on WhatsApp before we deliver.
terms.s3Body: The delivery charge and the expected time are not fixed on the website. We confirm both with you on WhatsApp before a rider is sent. Times are estimates and can change with weather, traffic and demand.
terms.s4Body: Pay cash on delivery, or by QR (eSewa, Khalti, Fonepay) at the door. The website does not take payments.
terms.s5Body: We deliver during the opening hours shown on the site, in the areas we list. If your area is not listed, we will tell you on WhatsApp whether we can reach you.
terms.s6Body: Tell us on WhatsApp as early as you can. We can usually change or cancel an order before the shop starts preparing it. After that, changes may not be possible.
terms.s7Body: If something is wrong, message us on WhatsApp as soon as you notice, ideally within 24 hours, with your order details. We will look into it and do our best to put it right.
terms.s8Body: Liquor is sold and delivered only to adults aged 18 and over. We check ID at the door and may refuse or cancel delivery if you cannot show it.
terms.s9Body: Offers have their own conditions, such as a minimum order or an end date, shown with the offer. A code is applied by our team when we confirm your order.
terms.s10Body: Please give accurate details and treat our riders with respect. We may decline orders that are fake, abusive or that we cannot deliver safely.
